questions.q: Which statement about the generalized ESD test is true?
options: It needs the exact number of outliers in advance
It needs only an upper limit r on the number of outliers
It works only on seasonal data
why: That is the advantage of the generalized test: no exact count.
It needs the season removed first.
It removes the most extreme value at each step.

questions.q: R values for i = 1..4 are 4.1, 3.6, 2.2, 2.9 and the critical values are 3.2, 3.2, 3.1, 3.1. How many outliers does the test report?
questions.why: R1 = 4.1 > 3.2, R2 = 3.6 > 3.2. R3 = 2.2 < 3.1 and R4 = 2.9 < 3.1. The largest i that passes is 2.
